You are continuing the build for Workstream 2 at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora`. Your plan has been approved. Execute it now — write all the code.

## What to build (approved plan):

### 1. Migration: `supabase/migrations/20260408400000_add_custom_form_fields.sql`

```sql
-- Custom form fields per job
CREATE TABLE public.job_form_fields (
  id          uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  job_id      uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  field_type  text NOT NULL CHECK (field_type IN ('text', 'number', 'select', 'multiselect', 'date', 'url', 'textarea', 'checkbox')),
  label       text NOT NULL,
  placeholder text,
  required    boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  options     text[],
  sort_order  integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  is_knockout boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  knockout_answer text,
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_form_fields_job ON public.job_form_fields(job_id, sort_order);
ALTER TABLE public.job_form_fields ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Job owner or team member can manage form fields
CREATE POLICY "Job team can manage form fields"
  ON public.job_form_fields FOR ALL TO authenticated
  USING (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.jobs j
      WHERE j.id = job_form_fields.job_id AND j.user_id = auth.uid()
    )
  );

-- Public can read form fields (needed for Apply page)
CREATE POLICY "Public can view form fields"
  ON public.job_form_fields FOR SELECT TO anon
  USING (true);

-- Allow authenticated users to also read
CREATE POLICY "Auth can view form fields"
  ON public.job_form_fields FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (true);

-- Store custom field responses + knockout status in applications
ALTER TABLE public.applications ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS custom_fields jsonb DEFAULT '{}';
ALTER TABLE public.applications ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS auto_disqualified boolean DEFAULT false;
ALTER TABLE public.applications ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS disqualify_reason text;

-- Auto-ack email settings on jobs
ALTER TABLE public.jobs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS auto_ack_enabled boolean DEFAULT true;
ALTER TABLE public.jobs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS auto_ack_subject text DEFAULT 'Thank you for your application!';
ALTER TABLE public.jobs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS auto_ack_body text DEFAULT 'Thank you for applying to {{job_title}}. We have received your application and will review it shortly. We will be in touch if your profile matches our requirements.';
```

### 2. New: `src/components/FormBuilder.tsx`
Read `src/components/JobDetailView.tsx` first (specifically the `JobMetadataSection` pattern around line 50 — collapsible section with save).

- Shows list of custom fields for a job
- Add field form: type dropdown (text/number/select/multiselect/date/url/textarea/checkbox), label, placeholder, required toggle, options (for select/multiselect), is_knockout toggle, knockout_answer
- Each field: label, type badge, required/knockout badges, edit/delete buttons
- Reorder via up/down arrows (updates sort_order)
- CRUD via `(supabase as any).from("job_form_fields")`
- Uses shadcn Card, Input, Select, Switch, Button, Badge

### 3. New: `src/components/AutoAckSettings.tsx`
- Small Card with: toggle (auto_ack_enabled), subject Input (with {{job_title}} placeholder hint), body Textarea (with {{job_title}}, {{candidate_name}} hints)
- Fetches current values from jobs table on mount
- Save button updates jobs table

### 4. Modify: `src/pages/Apply.tsx`
Read the FULL file first.
- After fetching job info, also fetch custom fields: `(supabase as any).from("job_form_fields").select("*").eq("job_id", jobId).order("sort_order")`
- Render custom fields dynamically below standard fields based on field_type
- Validate required custom fields
- Collect responses into `customFields: Record<string, any>`
- Send as stringified JSON `custom_fields` field in FormData

### 5. Modify: `src/components/ApplicationsTab.tsx`
Read the FULL file first.
- Add `custom_fields`, `auto_disqualified`, `disqualify_reason` to Application interface
- Show auto-disqualified badge (red "Disqualified" badge) in status area
- Add "Hide disqualified" toggle filter
- Show custom field responses in expandable section per application

### 6. Modify: `src/components/JobDetailView.tsx`
Read the FULL file first (~1882 lines).
- Import FormBuilder and AutoAckSettings
- Render FormBuilder inside the Applications tab area (or as a collapsible section near job settings)
- Render AutoAckSettings nearby
- Only show when isExistingJob

### 7. Modify: `supabase/functions/submit-application/index.ts`
Read the FULL file first.
- Accept `custom_fields` from body (parse as JSON)
- Store in applications.custom_fields column
- After insert: query `job_form_fields WHERE is_knockout = true AND job_id = ?`
- For each knockout field: compare `custom_fields[field.id]` to `field.knockout_answer`
- If match: UPDATE application set `auto_disqualified = true`, `disqualify_reason`, `status = 'rejected'`
- After knockout check: if `auto_ack_enabled` on job, send acknowledgement email via Resend
  - Use pattern from send-email edge function
  - Replace {{job_title}} and {{candidate_name}} in subject/body
  - Wrap in try/catch — failure is non-fatal
  - Get RESEND_API_KEY from env

## Constraints:
- NEVER edit `src/integrations/supabase/types.ts`
- `(supabase as any)` for all new tables/columns
- `@/` path alias
- shadcn-ui only
- Sonner toasts
- The Apply page is PUBLIC — custom fields fetched with anon policy
- Run `npm run build` at the end — MUST be zero TypeScript errors

Execute now. Write production code.
